title: incident-bot: runbook & SLO autolinking + on-call helper utilities
description:
Motivation: Improve on-call experience by surfacing relevant runbooks and SLO context automatically in incident-bot, and add a set of helper utilities for on-call responders. This PR implements a runbook autolinker (heuristic matching + deterministic tie-breaker), SLO hint surface for alerts, and a small UI helper for quick-runbook links in the on-call modal.

Changes: single service for matching runbooks to alerts, an SLO hinter that ranks runbooks by SLO relevance, a config flag to opt out of public runbook linking for private deployments, additional unit/integration tests, and docs updates.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement runbook linker service and API handler
- [x] Surface SLO hints in oncall UI
- [x] Add unit + integration tests for heuristics
- [x] Add privacy opt-out flag and docs
- [x] Manual QA: smoke-tested in staging with synthetic alerts

Testing notes: Initial CI revealed a flaky UI test which was fixed by stabilizing the mock time in oncall_helpers.test.tsx. Integration tests exercise the end-to-end matching and opt-out behavior. Rollout done as a staged feature flag (runbook_autolink_v2) to 10% then 100%.

Related: ENG-2589, PM-1042. For private deployments see deploy/values.incident-bot.yaml opt-out section.
